# a few days later, and the national spirits are clamped and re-read once.

	id = tfr_eng_core.1
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		tag = ENG
	}

	immediate = {
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
		ENG_refresh_modifiers = yes
	}
}
